$schema.description: Optional relative path to the JSON Schema of this file, for editor support. Loaders ignore it.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

minigames.description: Tag of all durations, thresholds and reward magnitudes in minigames.

name_key.description: String key of the minigame name.

when_key.description: String key of the When line.

stage.description: Part of the session in which the minigame occurs.

flight_phases.description: Flight phases in which the minigame can occur.

contracts.description: Contracts the minigame is limited to. Omit when unrestricted.

triggers.description: Conditions that start the minigame; any one suffices. Parts enable minigames through their enables_minigame rules.

review.description: Design review the trigger refers to.

category.description: Part category the trigger refers to.

anomaly.description: Anomaly card the trigger refers to.

failure_mode.description: Failure mode the trigger refers to.

event.description: Flight or session event the trigger refers to, for example conjunction_warning.

type.description: Minigame type (design section 10.2). cooperative is used by MG-28 and MG-30, which the catalog labels "Cooperative" without a sub-type.

duration_per_player.description: True if duration_s is per player (relay).

how_to_play_key.description: String key of the one-sentence instruction (design section 10.1, rule 4).

success_key.description: String key of the success rule.

always_succeeds.description: True if taking part counts as success.

params.description: Thresholds and windows sent to phones in mg.start, for example in_band_fraction_min.

aggregation.description: How individual results set the real flight value.

facts.description: Fact-bank IDs (F01 to F40, not flight phases) of the fact the minigame teaches. Empty or omitted when the fact of the minigame is not in the fact bank.

items.description: One reward. At least one of boost, effects, flag or text_key.

boost.description: Catalog boost granted at the earned tier.

boost_size.description: small when the catalog says a "small" boost; the magnitude is then a balance decision.

tiers.description: Tiers at which the reward applies. Omit for every tier. Platinum pays what Gold pays, so a Gold reward lists gold and platinum.

effects.description: Numeric effects outside the boost catalog.

flag.description: Qualitative reward Core acts on, for example prevents_recontact.

text_key.description: String key of the reward text for rewards outside the boost catalog.

shield_scope.description: Restriction the design puts on a Reliability Shield reward: descent = usable in the descent phase only, orbit = orbit phase only, crew_safety = protects crew safety only.

precision_target.description: Which error a Precision reward applies to, where the design names it in parentheses: landing_ellipse = "Precision (landing ellipse)". Omit when the design does not say.

design_notes.description: Designer-facing notes about ambiguities or decisions. Never shown to players and never localised.

detail_key.description: String key of the full How to play text of design section 10.5, for the Codex and the looping demo script.

crewed_only.description: True if the minigame occurs only on crewed contracts.

fact_key.description: String key of the one-line fact shown on the result screen, 25 words or fewer (design sections 10.1 and 12.1). Where the fact bank holds the fact, this is the text key of that fact.

reward_summary_key.description: String key of the Boost line of design section 10.5 as printed.

accessibility.description: Motor-accessibility modes every minigame must offer (design sections 10.1 rule 8 and 16).

relaxed_key.description: String key of the note describing Relaxed mode (wider windows, slower pace).

one_button_key.description: String key of the note describing the One-Button alternative. Hold-to-press can always switch to toggle.
